name: Muthoot Capital Services Limited
about: Muthoot Capital Services Limited, a non-banking finance company, provides fund and non-fund-based financial services in India. The company offers two-wheelers, new and used cars, secure business, used commercial vehicle loans, construction equipment loans, and loyalty loans; fixed deposits; and subordinated debentures. The Company also provides personal loans and business/corporate loans. It serves retail, corporate, and institutional clients through a network of branches. Muthoot Capital Services Limited was founded in 1994 and is based in Kochi, India.
